hook: Lift him too roughly, and this hypothermia rescue could stop his heart.
tiktok_caption: Hypothermia rescue: why rescuers handle a cold patient so gently. Yank him out of the ice, or slide him out flat: which would you do? hook: Spearmint and caraway get their smell from two mirror image molecules.
tiktok_caption: Mirror image molecules: spearmint and caraway both smell of carvone. Same molecule, so why does one smell like mint and the other like rye bread? The two forms are mirror images that can't be stacked, which makes carvone chiral, and the chiral receptors in your nose respond to each one differently. Organic chemistry, chirality and enantiomers. levlprep.com #organicchemistry #chemistry #chirality
yt_title: Mirror image molecules: why mint and rye bread smell different
yt_description:
Mirror image molecules: spearmint and caraway both get their smell from carvone. Same atoms and bonds, so why does one smell like mint and the other like rye bread? The two forms are mirror images that can't be stacked (chiral enantiomers), and the chiral receptors in your nose respond to each one differently.

Free organic chemistry notes and practice on chirality: https://levlprep.com/ochem/notes/chirality.html?ref=yt-mirror-mint
